title: CITY PARK STEALTH CAMPING!! Mowbray Park, Sunderland
description:
So guys it's Tuesday 3rd of January 2026 and I've decided to attempt a stealth camp at Mowbray Park in Sunderland City Centre. As usual it's raining and it's a bit dodgy because the local junkies tend to hang out around the park plus there's always the danger of dog or human 💩 Can i pull this one off guys? Well tune in, grab a beer and join me on another silly stealth camping adventure 🍺🥃🤪👍
